research_question: Can an evaluator-owned UI-only adapter reproduce the official API ui payload exactly at the same fixed states while eliminating vision encoding and frame-file side effects?

api_source.getAgentObservation: renders viewport, writes PNGs, encodes two vision PNGs, then calls ui.renderJSON and updates taskProgress/steps
api_source.renderJSON: returns the same ui payload but pops one extended message from its queue; comparison therefore uses separate identically initialized processes

alternatives.reason: agent-compatible but generates/encodes vision and writes frame files at every observation
removes disk writes but still renders and base64-encodes vision; does not prove UI-only semantic parity
renderJSON pops extended-message queue; sequential calls at one state can perturb comparison
identically seeded/process-isolated worlds each consume one UI read per state; compare canonical UI hashes step-by-step
changes third-party runtime and violates current research-only/native-pause boundary

selected_design.controlled_frame_directory: unique per cell; measure before cleanup

primary_endpoints: 20/20 official-to-ui_only ordered canonical UI hash vectors are exact at observations 0-1000
10/10 UI-only same-seed repeat ordered UI hash vectors are exact
all 30 cells are valid_complete with exact manifest identity, exit 0, counters 1..1001, 1000 successful action/tick transitions and pinned source identities
source-mirrored UI side-effect fingerprints match official mode for the allowlisted state fields
official cells produce exactly 1002 PNG files in isolated temporary directories; UI-only cells produce zero
secondary_endpoints: per-mode-pair raw monotonic seconds, UI-minus-official seconds, and UI/official ratio when both cells valid; descriptive nested only
official frame bytes per cell before cleanup
message queue 0/1/2 and dialog sentinel fixture results
falsifiers: any official-to-ui_only ordered UI hash vector mismatch
any invalid, timeout, crash, malformed or unobservable cell
any allowlisted post-observation state fingerprint mismatch
any UI-only frame or vision key
lifecycle: canonical -I -S -B launcher independently pins controller interpreter and canonical execution component paths/hashes; it reads each file once with O_NOFOLLOW, fsyncs a private seal, and execs only pinned bootstrap/run bytes
before marker, pinned run copies and exact-verifies a 7,136-entry CPython+site-packages content manifest and clean source archive; workers use only relocated runtime/source/bundle
one race-free outer SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP latch persists through managed cells. Signals before the blocked outcome-commit clear check dominate non-PASS; later signals are deferred until publication
absolute launch/execution deadline is sampled before PLANNED/setup, immediately before and after Popen, during wait, and after successful wait; no Popen when the fresh pre-call sample is expired
sandbox permits initial exec only and denies fork/spawn, network, and external writes; the session-leader worker cannot create an escaping descendant; unreaped remains dominant across later failures

worker streams use controller-created FDs plus inode-checked copy; frame directory uses retained dirfd; durable receipt root, all cell directories/files, ledger, pending, and result remain pinned by retained FDs and verified paths/inodes

every claimed sidecar for every status is path-bound and rehashed; each PLANNED cell must FINISH; valid cells/pairs are recomputed from pinned bytes; pending result/status/previous hash, FINALIZED, and published inode are mutually bound

approval derives execution root from pinned code and authority root from execution root+design+proposal; machine-bound clean/method/runtime/handoff receipts and a raw user authorization receipt are mandatory
marker is permanent. Logical handled failures close non-PASS when storage permits; SIGKILL/power/ENOSPC may remain CONSUMED_UNCLOSED_INVALID and never permit retry/PASS
scope_limits: a PASS admits source-mirrored adapter only for the pinned fixed ROTATE_DIRECTION/tick public-UI projection across two named families/seeds 0-4
it does not establish arbitrary action, dialog, inventory-changing, task-solving, visual, scorer, gold or full internal-state equivalence
official mode generates vision/frame artifacts; UI-only mode omits them
Python socket denial is defense-in-depth, not OS isolation
families n=2; 30 cells and 30 mode/repeat comparisons are nested technical evidence
no task outcome, TREE/TYPED behavior, model or ARGO efficacy
stopping_rule: one approved 30-cell run; completed parity mismatch is scientific FAIL; invalid/timeout/drift/unreaped/write-error is INVALID or INCOMPLETE; no retry/resume/repair

candidate_binding.selection_reason: mirror official render state mutations before renderJSON while excluding only graphical render/base64/PNG work
candidate_binding.sentinel_tests: 4/4 PASS; each fixture asserts exact official errors/ui/vision and UI-only errors/ui outer keys

timing: immediately after returned UI and api.taskProgress/api.steps update

cases: queue size 2 with two sequential reads

mismatch_interpretation: Any cross-mode mismatch yields PARITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED / ADAPTER_NOT_ADMITTED. It does not identify adapter causality because independent processes may differ through upstream unseeded state.

controller_binding.sandbox_policy: deny-default; child writes only per-cell ephemeral workdir; no network permission; Python socket block is defense in depth
controller_binding.runtime_capsule_smoke: sealed relocated Python/site-packages and pinned source imports under final sandbox; original runtime/source denied; fork denied; no scenario

review_convergence.caa4192_method_verdict: NOT_PASS; off-by-one and duplicate sentinel metadata fixed in successor
review_convergence.caa4192_runtime_verdict: NOT_PASS; five lifecycle blockers and closure addenda fixed in successor; immutable re-review pending

task_specific_os_isolation: single-process fixed sealed worker: no fork/spawn, network, or external write; explicit sensitive/original-runtime reads denied; not a general hostile-code secret sandbox
deadline_semantics: 5520 seconds is a launch_and_execution deadline, not a bound on kernel Popen latency or mandatory fsync closure. No Popen is called after a fresh expired pre-call sample.
environment_provenance_limitation: Worker CPython prefix and site-package bytes are exact-content manifested, copied, and pre/final verified. macOS kernel, dyld shared cache, system frameworks, sandbox-exec, and the controller interpreter runtime are the host TCB.
strong_closure: retained receipt-root/directory/file FDs and persistent ledger FD prevent worker confused-deputy paths and detect drift at validation/publication checkpoints. Malicious concurrent same-UID mutation after the last check remains host TCB.
authority_trust_boundary: Explicit user authority is received by the trusted parent daemon/API session. File gates and raw receipt make it auditable and block accidental launch; malicious same-UID agents/processes and post-check seal/artifact replacement are host/orchestrator TCB, not cryptographically excluded.
post_run_admission: Controller PASS is provisional. Bound verify_result.py must independently rederive and publish PASS; bound admit_result.py reruns it and emits ADMITTED only on exact verifier-receipt equality, controller PASS, and root equality.
